title: Robert Temple's conversation with a female plasma being on a flight to Singapore

tellings.quote: he described a moment he was flying on an airplane and he said a plasma being entered the airplane and he had a lengthy conversation with her.

plain: The author Robert Temple is said to have described a flight to Singapore during which a "plasma being", a living thing made of glowing charged gas, entered the airplane, and he had a lengthy conversation with her. The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove tells Michels this as something Temple told him, giving no more detail about what was said.
